meta.title: Entrepreneurship Skills & Ability Test
meta.description: A detailed 500-question reflection across 20 dimensions of entrepreneurship skill and readiness.

levels.label: Highly Developed Entrepreneurship Readiness
levels.desc: Your current entrepreneurial habits are strong across opportunity, validation, finance, execution, leadership, adaptation, and responsible decision-making.

levels.label: Strong Entrepreneurship Readiness
levels.desc: Most entrepreneurial skill areas are well supported, with a few dimensions that could become more consistent or evidence-led.

levels.label: Developing Entrepreneurship Readiness
levels.desc: Several useful foundations are present, though validation, finance, sales, execution, or leadership may vary by situation.

levels.label: Emerging Entrepreneurship Readiness
levels.desc: Some foundations support entrepreneurship, while customer evidence, planning, financial understanding, and disciplined action need development.

levels.label: Limited Current Entrepreneurship Readiness
levels.desc: Current habits may leave ideas under-tested or execution inconsistent. Start with customer discovery, a small experiment, basic numbers, and review.

levels.label: Entrepreneurship Foundations Need Attention
levels.desc: Several entrepreneurship foundations appear limited right now. Build one practical skill at a time and seek qualified guidance where stakes are high.
